Scope: collector and local roads; potable water, sewage, storm drainage, irrigation, TSE, medium-voltage, street lighting and telecom networks; a sewage pump station and storm drainage ponds; boundary fence, guard room and utility buildings.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At the 26-Oct-2026 data date the project is 20.8% complete against 36.4% planned in the baseline (SPI 0.57), and against 32.1% in the contractor's recovery plan (SPI 0.65). This week added 0.34% against 0.54% planned.

The schedule update finishes the project more than four months late. The P6 update with data date 26-Oct-2026 schedules project completion on 15-Jul-2027, 132 days after the contract completion date of 05-Mar-2027. The weekly report still forecasts 05-Mar-2027 with no change to any milestone. Finishing on time needs about 4.4% physical progress a week for the 18 weeks left, against 0.34% this week.

Data notes

  • Only one weekly report has been uploaded for this project (W04 folder), so week-on-week figures such as quantities executed this week cannot be computed yet.
  • The Milestones sheet states contract week 42 of 60, used as the report week. Whole weeks from site handover to the data date give 41.
  • Planned progress to date is 36.4% in the progress summary but 34.3% for October in the monthly chart data.
  • The weekly report forecasts completion on 05-Mar-2027 with zero variance, while the P6 update and the WBS summary PDF dated 26-Oct-2026 both finish on 15-Jul-2027. The recovery plan summary in the chart data finishes on 06-Mar-2027.
  • In the dashboard's progress overview, the Roads and CCTV rows have their names swapped; the Progress sheet was used instead.
  • The Conclusion sheet and the dashboard label cost-based progress as "actual" progress; it is not used in this report.
  • The Conclusion sheet is headed "Dammam", reports 260,000 m³ of earthworks against 428,344 m³ in the Major Quantities sheet, and gives network lengths that differ from the Procurement sheet (for example storm pipes 4,838 m against 4,672 m).
  • The invoice summary says 3 invoices were submitted, but the invoice log lists 4 with a total of 10,524,342 SAR. The log also shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000 and an EAC of 20,900,000, which do not match this contract.
  • Several sheets carry other projects' identifiers or old dates: the QC checklist and FIR summary use project DHRT-02-001, the risk register uses DAMT-01-002 (Dammam), and the HSE inspection covers 27-Jan to 03-Feb-2026.
  • The issue log closes the advance payment issue, but the P6 update and the risk log both show it as still open.
  • The dashboard's resources panel shows January head counts (9.9 planned, 12 actual) instead of October.
  • The Schedule sheet counts 1,271 activities; the uploaded P6 file has 1,065.
  • The physical forecast curve ends at 100.4% in February 2027.
  • The Procurement sheet marks the potable water pipe delivery finish of 09-Jan-2027 as actual, although the date is in the future.
  • The uploaded PowerPoint is the MODON report guide with an older data snapshot (contract week 35 of 60, 95,730 man-hours); it was not used for figures.
